summary.text: Robyn Frier is a Democratic member of the Alaska House of Representatives for District 40, serving in the 2025-2026 legislature.

paragraphs.text: According to the Alaska Legislature's member page, Frier is from Utqiaġvik, attended Mt. Edgecumbe High School in Sitka, and was president of the North Slope Borough School District Board of Education.

The page lists Frier's professional roles in human resources: assistant director at Arctic Slope Native Association, executive director of human resources at Iḷisaġvik College, and director of human resources at the North Slope Borough School District.
